name: Oil Storage Tunnels
objection: Short visit and Wikivoyage entry dated 2015; opening status could have changed.

name: Fannie Bay Gaol
objection: Could be seen as one more Darwin museum; but it is a distinct draw (gallows, cells).

name: Burnett House
objection: For: architecture of the Top End and a harbour-side stop. Against: a tea room, open mainly Sundays, interior access unconfirmed.

name: Museum and Art Gallery of the Northern Territory
East Point Reserve
objection: Overlaps with Lake Alexander and the military museum inside it; the reserve is the unit.

name: Lake Alexander
objection: For: safe swimming when the sea has stingers. Against: part of East Point Reserve, local recreation.

name: Casuarina Coastal Reserve
objection: Beach/reserve overlap with Casuarina Beach, handled by rejecting the beach entry.

name: Wagait Beach
objection: For: day trip with ferry, beach, WWII gun emplacement. Against: one counted source, local holiday community.

name: Howard Springs Nature Park
objection: For: a recognised swimming and picnic stop. Against: one counted source, local park; Wikivoyage Darwin does not name it.

name: Aquascene
objection: Tide-dependent, so not always available; operating times are set by the tide.

name: Batchelor Butterfly and Petting Farm
objection: For: family stop in Litchfield's gateway. Against: one source, small commercial venue.

name: Buley Rockhole
objection: Part of Litchfield park, but a distinct swim stop.

name: Tolmer Falls
objection: Viewing platform only; short visit; plunge pool closed to swimmers (wildlife).

name: Magnetic Termite Mounds
objection: A 15-minute platform stop; kept as a named feature.

name: Tjaynera Falls (Sandy Creek)
objection: For: genuine swim destination. Against: 4WD-only access and a minority of visitors.

name: Walker Creek
objection: For: good swim and walk start. Against: mainly a campground and trail junction.

name: The Lost City
objection: 4WD only, so many visitors cannot reach it; still a named headline feature.

name: Blyth Homestead
objection: For: heritage stop with story. Against: 4WD-only, ruin.

name: Tabletop Track
objection: Few walkers; but the rules name multi-day tracks.

name: Adelaide River
objection: The draws are cruise and cemetery; a small town stop.

name: Adelaide River War Cemetery
objection: For: a quiet, well-kept site of real interest. Against: memorial, 20-minute visit.

name: The Big Boxing Crocodile
objection: Tiny stop; but quirky icons are explicitly in scope.

name: Fogg Dam Conservation Reserve
objection: Seasonal quality; a drive-across dam.

name: Corroboree Billabong
objection: For: crocodile-rich wetland a guide singles out. Against: inside Mary River National Park, and activity is mostly a cruise.

name: Mary River National Park
objection: Thin park (a few spots); acceptable as a standalone spot.

name: Mandorah
objection: For: ferry day trip, pub on the water. Against: small settlement, no standalone listing of a stop; consider with Wagait Beach.

name: Cullen Bay
objection: For: waterfront promenade a visitor might spend an hour on. Against: dining/marina precinct.

name: Deckchair Cinema
objection: For: a Darwin signature evening, seasonal venue is fine. Against: it is a screening, effectively an evening event, not half-hour sightseeing.

name: Tiwi Islands
objection: Access is only via an organised tour, so it is a fly-in or ferry day trip.

name: Patakijiyali Museum
objection: For: Tiwi history and art. Against: short hours, reached via tours, one source.

name: Garig Gunak Barlu National Park
objection: For: marine turtles, wilderness, Victoria Settlement. Against: rarely visited and no counted source reached.
